hook: AI gave me a 47-step plan when I asked for help with one decision. 🙃
caption:
AI gave me a 47-step plan when I asked for help with one decision. 🙃

Asked ChatGPT to help me figure out whether to take on a new client.

It gave me a framework. With tiers. And sub-bullets. And a scoring matrix.

I just needed someone to think out loud with me for 30 seconds.

Here's the thing nobody talks about: AI doesn't know if you're a "just tell me the answer" person or a "walk me through the logic" person.

It doesn't know if bullet points calm you down or stress you out.

It doesn't know you hate when someone says "it depends" without actually committing to a direction.

So it defaults to Thorough. Comprehensive. Balanced.

Aka: the response that works for no one in particular.

That's the gap bootfile.ai exists to close.

Your BootFile teaches AI how your brain actually works — are you a fast-twitch decision maker or a deliberate one? Do you need context first or conclusions first? Are you the person who wants to be challenged or the person who needs encouragement before critique?

Same question. Completely different useful answer.

The AI isn't broken. It just doesn't know you yet.
